::: {#exr-pig-say-pen}
Which core modeling functions produce output 1 when the input is zero?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_psp.1.32do
- 'hillside() & flat()':
    correct: false
    feedback: 'No, the output of hillside() is 1/2 when the input is zero'
- 'flat() & exp2()':
    correct: true
- 'flat() & log2()':
    correct: false
    feedback: 'log2() is heading off to minus infinity as the input gets close to zero.'
- 'osc() & flat()':
    correct: false
    feedback: 'Sorry. osc(0) is zero.'
```
